#!/bin/bash
# runc 1.1 makes the whole tree read-only with rro; the flags still have to be repeated
sudo python3 - /var/lib/bench50335957/bundle/config.json <<'PY'
import json, sys
p = sys.argv[1]
c = json.load(open(p))
for m in c['mounts']:
    if m['destination'] == '/test-proc':
        m['options'] = ['rbind', 'rro', 'nosuid', 'nodev', 'noexec']
json.dump(c, open(p, 'w'), indent=2)
PY

#!/bin/bash
# findmnt /proc says: rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime
findmnt -no OPTIONS /proc
sudo python3 - /var/lib/bench50335957/bundle/config.json <<'PY'
import json, sys
p = sys.argv[1]
c = json.load(open(p))
for m in c['mounts']:
    if m['destination'] == '/test-proc':
        m['options'] = ['rbind', 'ro', 'nosuid', 'noexec', 'nodev', 'relatime']
json.dump(c, open(p, 'w'), indent=2)
PY

#!/bin/bash
sudo python3 - /var/lib/bench50335957/bundle/config.json <<'PY'
import json, sys
p = sys.argv[1]
c = json.load(open(p))
c['linux']['namespaces'] = [n for n in c['linux']['namespaces'] if n['type'] != 'user']
c['linux'].pop('uidMappings', None)
c['linux'].pop('gidMappings', None)
json.dump(c, open(p, 'w'), indent=2)
PY

#!/bin/bash
# the launcher is what adds the flags: make it stop doing so
sudo tee /var/lib/bench50335957/bin/runc >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
exec /var/lib/bench50335957/runc --root /run/bench50335957/runc "$@"
EOF
sudo chmod 755 /var/lib/bench50335957/bin/runc
